visual_identity.core_identity: Mindless amorphous dungeon organisms defined by viscosity, shape, transparency or surface behavior, and contact with architecture rather than faces or limbs.
visual_identity.silhouette: Simple blob, sheet, cube, or flowing mass depending on variant, with readable contact against floor, walls, stairs, bars, or objects.
visual_identity.head_features: No head, eyes, mouth, or face unless a specific canonical variant explicitly requires one.
visual_identity.body_shape: No fixed skeleton or limbs; form conforms to surroundings and variant-specific geometry.
visual_identity.surface: Broad open regions with sparse ripples, bubbles, drips, or gloss lines.
must_avoid: tentacle-monster anatomy unless variant requires it

accuracy_checks: body contact with environment explains its form

known_failure_modes.symptom: ooze gains cute eyes or smile
known_failure_modes.correction: remove all facial features and restore shape/environment-based identity

known_failure_modes.symptom: dark ooze becomes a solid black shape
known_failure_modes.correction: use outline-driven form with open white interior and sparse contour marks
